about: CableBox 42 retro ads (stage 1). Made-up brands only; phone numbers only 555-0100 to 555-0199 (tools/retro-ads/check_ads.py). Texts are English; the cards look each one up in strings.po (translations). Fields: fmt pitch|kids|local|psa|video (stage 2: infomercial|contest|classifieds), flav G K S M L, time morn day prime late (empty: any), hours [first, last] local hours, season holiday winter newyear spring summer school fall halloween (empty: any), weather cold hot rain snow (stage 2 tie-in), not_weather, claims (says what the weather is: only with a real reading), era 90s|2000s (follows Promo style), gag (running-gag group), theme video (video-themed: at most one a break, and a capped share of a channel's retro ads, like the videocassette cards), next (stage 2: the follow-up card).
